quests.title: The Roll of the Isles
quests.summary: Mann, Shetland and the Channel Islands each keep a yearly ritual in one ledger, and some pages have gone missing. Follow the Roll by ferry, from Tynwald to Up Helly Aa to Liberation Day.

steps.text: Hear about Tynwald from the Clerk at the Douglas tram depot.
Search the prompt corner of the Gaiety Theatre.
Tell Miss Quayle what you found.
Sing a shanty clean with the Ferry Crew Skipper in the Lounge at Lerwick.
Search the galley shed in Lerwick for the missing pages.
Question Halcrow the Binder in the galley shed.
Read the receipt in the Guernsey Occupation Museum.
Listen to the Museum Volunteer in Guernsey.
Listen to the Tunnel Historian at the Jersey War Tunnels.
Ring a touch with the Bell Captain at St Helier's church.
Name who held the pages, at the Gaiety in Douglas.
See the first Gathering of the Isles on the Douglas prom.

quests.reward: The Roll of the Isles Ribbon (a charm: tide moves hit harder), the Casebook reward, and standing on Mann, in Scotland and in the Channel Islands. And a Gathering on the Douglas prom.
